title: Introduce pluggable policy-evaluator and compact fallback path for region-aware routing
creator: Priya Patel
description:
Problem: The current smart routing codebase tightly couples policy evaluation, region affinity scoring, and fallback orchestration. This coupling has led to several maintenance pain points: long codepaths that lock global state during evaluation, duplicated fallback logic across region adapters, and brittle rollout behavior when we add new policy rules.

Goal: Break the policy engine into a pluggable evaluator interface, collapse multiple fallback paths into a single compact fallback coordinator, and clean up regional adapters to use a shared scoring util. This should reduce lock contention, make new policy rules simpler to add, and make fallbacks deterministic and easy to trace.

Success criteria (measurable):
- 20% reduction in p50 decision latency in the routing hotpath under representative load (benchmarks in /benchmarks/smart-router).
- Remove two global locks used during route evaluation (verified by code search and CI assertions).
- Unified fallback coordinator replaces the three duplicated fallback implementations across region adapters.
- New evaluator interface has a unit-test coverage target >= 90% and integration tests exercising canary and sudden-capacity-failure scenarios.

Out of scope: Full rollout of policy DSL; this ticket focuses on runtime interfaces and cleanup only. Policy authoring UX will be a follow-up (tracked in PM backlog).

2025-02-18 - Miguel Torres: Spike results: prototype evaluator as an interface + adapter pattern in routing/eval. Bench locally: route decision p50 reduced by ~12% for short sequences. Found global lock around RouteContext that serializes scoring; need to remove or narrow its scope.

2025-02-20 - Aisha Khan: Design review feedback: suggested moving region weight normalization into a shared util to avoid per-adapter quirks; flagged an interaction between prefix caching and fallback sequencing that could cause stale KV caches to be preferred in rare races. Added follow-up: ENG-30211 (cache-consistency-check).

2025-02-22 - Miguel Torres: Implemented compact fallback coordinator (WIP). Pushed draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/8349 — includes evaluator interface, coordinator, and adapter migration for eu-west-1 and us-central-1. Running CI integration tests; currently failing one test that simulates concurrent route updates.

2025-02-25 - Priya Patel: PM review: ensure rollout plan includes feature flag gating and telemetry for fallback decisions. Asked for an event-level trace field to annotate which fallback rule fired; this will be a small schema change to trace/span metadata. Added to implementation checklist.

2025-02-27 - Code review (design-owner): feedback from runtime team: prefer explicit immutable input structs to evaluator rather than the current dynamic map to keep the hotpath allocation low. Miguel to refactor to use ScoreRequest struct. Estimated 1 day to refactor.

2025-03-02 - Miguel Torres: Addressed comments and reduced allocations by using ScoreRequest. Local benchmarks now show p50 improvement of 21% on a synthetic load that mirrors CI. Preparing rollout plan: canary to 5% of traffic in eu-west-1 for 48 hours, with automatic rollback if error-rate or latency regressions observed. Monitoring dashboard: runtime->router->decision-latency and router->fallback->count.
